chunks: If one of you approaches his wife, then let him remember Allah, for whoever does not remember Allah during intercourse, and a child is born from it, that is a partnership of Satan; and that is recognized by love for us and hatred for us.

key_terms.أَهْلَهُ: his wife or spouse in the context of marital relations
key_terms.بُغْضِنَا: through hatred for us, meaning the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.بِحُبِّنَا: through love for us, meaning the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.شِرْكُ شَيْطَانٍ: a satanic share or partnership in the act's spiritual consequence
key_terms.فَلْيَذْكُرِ اللَّهَ: let him remember Allah through dhikr at that moment
key_terms.وَلَدٌ: a child born from that union

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teach about remembering Allah before intercourse?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs the believer to remember Allah before marital intercourse. It warns that neglecting dhikr at that moment has spiritual consequences, and it links the resulting sign of purity or corruption to love or hatred toward the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.
